thesis: A net-cash, newly profitable digital remitter with sharply rising margins and an 8.98% FCF yield trades at the bottom of its own P/FCF range, pricing a fade its raised guidance does not show.
reason: Scorecard gives conviction 4: high, rising returns, net cash, and both discount and trend points. Python sets the volatility-scaled core size; cash cannot fund a full position above the 1.5% floor, so the conviction-3 HRB holding is sold to fund it.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 8%, reversing most of the step-up from 2.2% a year earlier to 13.0%.
TTM ROIC falls below 20%, showing the returns step-up was not durable.
TTM FCF margin falls below 12%, back near the 11.1% of a year earlier.
A regulatory outcome (AUSTRAC or US remittance rules) restricts a major corridor or imposes a material penalty, disclosed in a filing.

replacement_reason: HRB is held at conviction 3 with its remaining upside mostly shareholder yield after a re-rating (its own thesis); RELY clears the buy bar at conviction 4 with rising margins and a discount, and current cash cannot fund a full position above the 1.5% floor.
